item.summary: docs(agents): require exact-head ClawSweeper re-review after post-review pushes (#119069) The no-round-trip clause from #111385 covered the unchanged-head case; once rank-up moves are applied the old comment attests stale code. Head unchanged: land without re-review, as before. Head changed after review: one exact-head re-review, land when no actionable finding and no remaining rank-up move.
